Recorded claim:
Both test_cardDAV_syncV1.js and test_cardDAV_syncV2.js add the same PopularityIndex 10-to-20 case. Each waits for the first local addrbook-contact-updated notification, checks that no second sync-triggered update followed, then checks the local property persisted. The first patch also changed shared CardDAV server startup from add_task to add_setup, keeping it setup rather than a counted test. For changes to shared CardDAV behavior, cover both sync versions with the same observable contract. The 2024 no-second-event check used a 500 ms delay; that is the historical test technique, not a general rule to prefer sleeps.
